# Pass Two — Improved Execution Plan

Frames rise and fade, yet truth in evidence must stay;
The Awtsmoos renews the code, and verification lights the way.

## Discovery
1. Map `apps/` and neighboring creator routes.
2. Search source for movie/animation engines and rendering libraries.
3. Read app entries, shared modules, tests, and package metadata in bounded groups.
4. Trace affected routes and runtime dependencies.

## Architecture
5. Select smallest shared contract that fits discovered engines.
6. Preserve renderer-specific 2D/3D personality behind explicit adapters.
7. Introduce AI-friendly normalized movie data and capability metadata.
8. Make timeline/actions/cameras/characters/text/shapes/particles composable.

## Product
9. Refine mobile-first stage, transport, scene navigation, and creation controls.
10. Create a ~180-second showcase with many scenes and camera angles.
11. Include shapes, particles, characters, animated text, infographic/tutorial sequences.

## Verification
12. Syntax/type/lint/build tests that exist in the project.
13. Focused movie schema/timeline tests.
14. Browser runtime smoke tests for each app.
15. Narrow viewport interaction checks.
16. Verify duration and feature coverage from actual loaded movie data.
17. Read back every touched file and resolve delta.
